nodes.name: Weekly Cron (Fri 5PM)
nodes.notes: Fires every Friday at 5:00 PM UTC. Adjust the cron expression or timezone in the node settings.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Click 'Test workflow' to run manually at any time.

nodes.name: Set Variables
nodes.notes: All configurable variables. Override via n8n environment variables or edit defaults here.

nodes.name: Compute Date Range
nodes.notes: Calculates the lookback window (default: 7 days) for all GitHub API queries.

nodes.name: Fetch Commits
nodes.notes: Fetches up to 100 commits from the past week. Uses GitHub token if provided.

nodes.name: Fetch Closed Issues
nodes.notes: Fetches closed issues updated in the lookback window.

nodes.name: Fetch Merged PRs
nodes.notes: Fetches recently closed PRs, then filters for merged-only in the next step.

nodes.name: Merge & Transform Data
nodes.notes: Combines all three GitHub API responses into a structured payload. Filters PRs to merged-only and issues to truly closed within the window.

nodes.name: Build Claude Prompt
nodes.notes: Constructs the system and user prompts for Claude, with language-aware instructions. Supports EN, FR, ES, ZH, DE, JA.

nodes.name: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514)
nodes.notes: Calls the Anthropic Messages API with claude-sonnet-4-20250514. Timeout set to 60s for longer responses.

nodes.name: Extract & Format Summary
nodes.notes: Extracts text from Claude's response, builds a formatted summary with header/stats, and prepares delivery-specific versions.

nodes.name: Send to Discord
nodes.notes: Posts the summary to a Discord channel via webhook.

nodes.name: Send to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts the summary to a Slack channel via incoming webhook.

parameters.subject: =Weekly Dev Summary: {{ $('Extract & Format Summary').first().json.github_owner }}/{{ $('Extract & Format Summary').first().json.github_repo }} ({{ $('Extract & Format Summary').first().json.since_display }} - {{ $('Extract & Format Summary').first().json.until_display }})

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Sends summary via email. Requires SMTP credentials configured in n8n.
